name: mdx-lesson-promotion-lane-contract
purpose: Define the review lane that folds live evidence receipts into drafted candidate lessons and carries each one through governed, receipt-backed judgment to its promoted, rejected, or superseded end state before MDx memory or runtime behavior can change.
fleet_distillation_gate: a machine league distillation note drafts a lesson only when its pairwise comparison receipt records pairwise_outcome external_win with distillation_candidate_allowed true
dedup_rule: a candidate whose source receipt is cited by a learning.candidate.rejected receipt, or whose candidate id is cited as promotion_id by a learning.judgment.decided receipt, leaves the draft lane
draft_flag_rule: machine-authored draft text is scanned deterministically for instruction-injection shapes at the projection seam; a match flags the draft for the reviewer instead of hiding it, and flagged or not, no draft can activate memory without the governed human chain

states.meaning: A plausible lesson exists, but the lane has not proven every promotion-rule requirement.
The item is visible only to show what evidence is missing before review.
The evidence is sufficient for accountable human or policy judgment, but no behavior has changed.
A governed judgment, memory promotion request, and memory activation receipt chain recorded approved MDx-owned memory.
A governed rejection receipt records the accountable no and removes the candidate from the draft lane without deleting history.
A governed supersede receipt retires the activated memory and links it to the receipt that replaced it.

promotion_rule: source of truth is updated before generated artifacts refresh
local check proves generated contract alignment
